title: Turkish Kofte with Bok Choi Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make Turkish-inspired dish featuring kofte and bok choy stir-fried in a savory sauce.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and ginger; cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add kofte; cook for 2-3 minutes, until browned.
Add bok choy; cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted.
Stir in soy sauce; cook for 1 minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro (optional).
Cook kofte to an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Cook bok choy until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
